description: Get HTML of the page or an element. Output is capped (see maxBytes) and cut at a tag boundary; narrow it with `selector` rather than raising the cap when you can. Password field values are always blanked.

allFrames.description: Act on the first match in ANY frame (the element may be in an iframe)

maxBytes.description: Cap returned content at N UTF-8 bytes (default 262144); the full payload still lands in results/

name: get_html
